guides.title: DSWD crisis assistance (AICS)
guides.scope: National DSWD program; applicable to residents of Siquijor subject to assessment
guides.eligibility: Indigent, marginalized, vulnerable, disadvantaged, and financially incapacitated people and families in crisis, based on social-worker assessment.

requirements.item: Valid government-issued ID of client/person interviewed
requirements.copies: Original presented during assessment and two photocopies

requirements.item: Supporting documents specific to the crisis
requirements.details: Medical records and bills/prescription/laboratory order and quotation, funeral death record and contract/account, or transportation circumstance records as applicable.

steps: Document screening through DSWD crisis-intervention services.
Social-worker interview and assessment of eligibility, need, documents, appropriate assistance, and recommended amount.
Approval and release instructions for assistance or referral.
guides.assessmentBasis: Actual need, supporting records, and available program funds; no fixed grant amount promised.

guides.title: First-time adult Philippine passport
guides.scope: Adult first-time applicants at domestic Philippine consular offices
requirements: Documentary proof of Philippine citizenship, such as PSA Certificate of Live Birth or Report of Birth for natural-born applicants
At least one accepted valid ID, such as PhilID/ePhilID
PSA Certificate of Marriage or Report of Marriage for women choosing their spouse’s surname
guides.documentCopies: Original documents and ID with one photocopy for submission. Citizenship and personal circumstances determine supporting records.
steps: Book at the official DFA appointment system and complete payment.
Attend the selected office for appointment verification.
Complete information encoding, document scanning, photo and biometric capture.
Follow release instructions and check passport details upon receipt.
